theme: Accept arrivals now, chase the hindsight packer
title: The Unseen Tide: Cargo Admission Policy
strategies: accept-everything baseline: admit every lot that still fits, no density filtering at all (reproduces the evaluator's weak reference)

static density cutoff: estimate one fixed value-density threshold from the preview manifest (its mean density) and hold it constant for the whole tide, ignoring remaining capacity and any drift once real lots arrive

dual-fitting shadow price: anchor the threshold to the preview's fractional-knapsack cutoff density (lambda*) instead of the mean, then make the bar climb as capacity is actually consumed, so a busier-than-expected tide is met with rising selectivity instead of early overcommitment

drift-corrected pacing: on top of the capacity ramp, cancel its on-pace component and add a directional nudge from the preview's own early-vs-late density trend plus a small reaction to the observed running-average density, so the policy neither overreacts to a normal pace nor misreads which direction value is moving
